avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. Being so self conscious about my arms I only wear 3/4 sleeves to try and hide as much as possible on my arms in the summer. I've tried many anti-crepe creams but they didn't do anything and were always sticky which drives me crazy. I know this was a little pricey but out of desperation I decided to give it a try. I love it! Retinol is really the only thing that helps with any kind of wrinkles or crepe skin. I love Shea Butter and this has made such a difference for me! I highly recommend this if you're as self conscious as I am! This is a great product!

I’ve been using this retinol neck cream consistently and have started to notice a visible difference. My skin feels smoother, and the fine lines on my neck are becoming less noticeable. The cream has a lightweight, non-greasy formula that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any white residue behind. It also has little to no strong scent, which I appreciate. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and comfortable after each use. If you’re looking for a retinol neck cream that’s easy to use and delivers gradual results, this is definitely worth trying.
Smells nice, pleasant and nongreasy feel. Probably only marginally effective for improving skin tone but a nice lotion that sinks in and leaves akin soft.

avis.titre: Promising results after just a few days
avis.texte: I've only been using this product for about 4-5 days, but I'm already noticing some positive changes in the appearance and texture of my skin. It applies very easily, spreads effortlessly, and absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or sticky. So far, I'm really enjoying it. My only small criticism is the scent. If the fragrance were a little more pleasant, it would be close to perfect. Overall, I'm very happy with my purchase and look forward to seeing the long-term results.
It's a small amount for a lot of $. Must apply daily to see any results, took about 2 weeks to see a difference. Leaves your skin moisturized and soft.

Great body lotion I absolutely love this body lotion! It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin incredibly soft and smooth without feeling greasy. I’ve noticed a more even texture and a healthy glow with consistent use. Definitely a product I’ll keep in my body-care routine! Smooth and hydrating This retinol body lotion has been a great addition to my skincare routine. It leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and noticeably smoother. I especially love how quickly it absorbs and that it doesn’t leave a sticky or heavy feeling. I would definitely recommend it! Love the results I’m really impressed with this product! My skin feels smoother, softer, and more hydrated after using it consistently. The texture is lightweight and easy to apply, and it absorbs beautifully. Definitely worth trying if you want smoother-looking skin!
I've been using this daily, for a couple weeks. It seams to help tighten my skin, I can see a difference. Looking forward to seeing what it looks like in a couple months.
My skin didn’t know what it was missing. Holy Grail of lotions.

Well I’ve only had it for 1 day. On application it was not greasy nor heavy and sticky, which is what it claims. I need to wait a month to see visible improvements in skin crepyness according to the info I have read. Delivery was prompt.
I tried this couple of bottles. Really take care of skin to reduce spots, uneven skin and stretch marks not completely though. I love this product. Will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Muy buen producto para estrías rojas
avis.texte: Me lo recomendó mi dermatóloga para tratar las estrías que recién me salieron por mi embarazo (lo usé después de dar a luz) y es excelente producto, vale la pena cada peso.

Wow. What a huge difference this lotion makes. I have used multiple lotions. I use oil every day. I’m constantly hydrating my skin. Everything I put on has nothing that compares to this. I use just this for two days and the dents lines crimping whatever you call it above my knees and the top of my legs is gone. They are stunningly beautiful I will never ever not purchase this again.
I love this lotion. I’ve noticed my skin looks healthier than it did when I was using medical grade skincare.

I’ve been using this for 3 weeks on my stretch marks. I found it listed on an article as a good product to use, due to the ingredients. I’m not sure if this is just natural healing (I’m 4 months pp) but it looks like its made a difference, the top is before and bottom is after. I’m not sure if this product is meant for stretch marks but hey, it seems to be working. My stretch marks have lightened and the aren’t as deep anymore. Some even look like they are gone now. I will continue to use and hope it gets even better.

I liked the way this product arrived safety sealed, packaged nicely. I don’t like the pump dispenser or that you’re unable to see how much product is left. There’s only a small amount anyways (4oz) considering it’s for your body. It provided no moisturizing feel for my skin so I had to follow up with a good moisturizer on my body. I noticed no difference in my skin although I’m fully aware that retinol takes months to show results as I use retinaldehyde on my face. I just don’t like this so I won’t purchase it again. I do enjoy other PC products.

The package was completely sealed with plastic but when I removed it and the cap the spout portion of the lotion was broken. I was not able to reattach it so instead I had to take out the other pieces and stick my hand in the tube to try and get it out. I learned that the mechanism to get the lotion out is quite complicated so it is not an ideal bottle to have broken. I am very sad since this is expensive lotion.
It arrived completely open. Sold as "new", but it's actually a returned bottle.

avis.titre: Product showed up damaged without a lid.
avis.texte: Disappointed because product showed up damaged missing a lid. Lotion crusty on the top.
